notes.title: Update 2.5.0 | Manual Gearbox, new main menu and beta steering wheel support

added new Main Menu and new Settings menu
 added rebindable keys
 added steering weehl support (beta)
 added tutorial box
 added option to switch to manual gearbox and manual shift gears
